description: This file defines the CandidateDecorator class, which provides additional behavior (decoration) for Candidate entities in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes methods for setting related employee data and formatting application dates, utilizing traits for ORM and date/time handling.

classes.name: CandidateDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds auxiliary functions to the Candidate entity, such as setting associated employee info and formatting the application date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a Candidate object and initializes the decorator.

methods.name: setAddedPersonById
methods.description: Sets the 'added person' (referring employee) for the candidate by employee ID.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the candidate's date of application formatted as a string.
